verdict.rationale: Aircall's own API documents pausing and resuming recording on a call, and a tutorial covers importing recordings and voicemail into your own infrastructure. Together these show recordings exist, can be controlled per call, and can be retrieved later. Nothing in the pack covers consent handling such as announcements, opt-in/opt-out, or jurisdiction-specific settings. missing for 10: jurisdiction-aware consent handling (consent prompts/announcements, per-region recording rules), in-product recording search/library for finding recordings later, automatic recording configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can record calls with the consent handling my jurisdictions require and find the recordings later
